notes.title: Patch Notes 10/28/22
notes.notes:
Multiple Bug Fixes Including
[list]
[*] Fixed bug allowing players to have negative money
[*] Fixed mini-game/tasks hours going into the several hundred
[*] Fixed pretty fun bug where, after losing, players could go to the high score screen and then go back, allowing them to continue the game with an empty van.
[/list]
